properties.name: ML-KEM-1024 / Crystals-Kyber-1024
properties.complexity_bounds: O(k^2 * n log n) polynomial ring operations, n=256, k=4

properties.name: Montgomery Modular Reduction
properties.complexity_bounds: Time: O(1) per word multiplication; Space: O(1)
properties.algorithm_variant: 16-bit word Montgomery reduction with signed SIMD multiplication

properties.name: ARM Scalable Vector Extension 2 (SVE2)
properties.throughput_bounds: Scalable vector length (128 to 2048 bits), operating on 16-bit lanes
properties.register_dependency: Scalable Z vector registers (Z0-Z31) and predicate registers (P0-P15)

properties.microarchitectural_effect: Multiply active 16-bit elements in Zn and Zm under predicate Pg, store low 16 bits in Zd
Signed saturating rounding doubling multiply returning high 16 bits for Montgomery step

properties.operation: Reduces intermediate products in polynomial NTT and point multiplication

properties.vector_width: 32x 16-bit coefficient lanes processed per 512-bit SVE vector cycle

properties.stage: Low 16-bit product generation step in Montgomery multiplication
High 16-bit signed product extraction for Montgomery reduction

properties.access_pattern: Read/Write 16-bit elements in vector registers controlled by active predicate lanes
Read/Write high-half product lanes across SVE scalable registers
